土壤“微食物网”（微生物-线虫-跳虫）如何驱动养分循环？

How does the soil 'microfood web' (microbes–nematodes–springtails) drive nutrient cycling?

微生物分解枯落释放矿质养分，线虫等微型动物捕食微生物调控其数量与活性，跳虫破碎有机质增大表面积，层层传递给植物可利用的氮磷，是地下养分的“发动机”。
Microbes decompose litter releasing mineral nutrients; microfauna like nematodes graze microbes, regulating their activity, while springtails shred litter, all passing plant-available N and P—the engine of belowground nutrients.

苔藓和地衣为什么能当空气污染的“指示生物”？

Why can mosses and lichens indicate air pollution?

它们直接从空气吸收水分和养分、没有真正根系保护，对二氧化硫、重金属和氮沉降极敏感，种类和盖度的变化能反映当地污染水平。
They absorb water and nutrients straight from air without root protection, so they are very sensitive to SO2, heavy metals and N deposition; shifts in species and cover reveal local pollution.

一克健康土壤里大约住着多少微生物？

Roughly how many microbes live in a gram of healthy soil?

一克肥沃土壤里可能有数十亿计的细菌，还有真菌、原生动物等，数量比地球上的人还多，它们是土壤健康的“小工人”。
A gram of fertile soil can hold billions of bacteria plus fungi and protists—more than all humans on Earth—the tiny workers of soil health.
